extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 9f5d518b3ce13e1ff70bd429f524f7b7998b0fa39d2bced1d0c989782544ed1a before extraction.
The PDF identifies the electrical die as MMBT5551L and lists MMBT5551LT1G in the ordering information; the LT1G suffix is the SOT-23 tape-and-reel ordering variant.
The datasheet's typical-characteristics plots are labelled for the combined MMBT5550L/MMBT5551L family and do not provide a separate curve for the MMBT5551 ordering suffix.
Table values for MMBT5551 were kept as guaranteed minimum or maximum bounds; no typical hFE value was invented from a bound.
Curve points are digitized readings from the plotted traces and are not interpolated between unmarked values.
No tabulated fT, Cobo, or Cibo value is provided; the reported values for those fields are digitized typical readings from Figures 10 and 12.
The electrical-characteristics table states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted; its pulse-test note specifies pulse width = 300 ms and duty cycle = 2.0%.
